"گوشه ای از خلق و کنجی از جهان - بر همه گنج روان خواهم گزید"
Translation: "A corner of people and a nook of the world - I will choose over all the flowing treasure"
Meaning: The poet prefers solitude and seclusion (a corner away from people, a nook of the world) over all worldly wealth and treasures. This is about the value of isolation/seclusion over material wealth.

Option 2:
"عزلت تو را به کنگره کبریا بُوَد - آن سقفگاه رابه از این نردبان مخواه"
Translation: "Your seclusion will reach the summit of greatness - Do not seek that roof from this ladder"
Meaning: This is a bit ambiguous. "عزلت" means seclusion/solitude. "کنگره کبریا" means the summit of greatness. The second line seems to be saying "don't seek that high place from this ladder" - perhaps meaning that seclusion itself leads to greatness, not through conventional means (the ladder). It seems to be praising seclusion as a path to spiritual elevation.

Option 3:
"گوشه گیری فیض ها دارد در این وحشت سرا - قطره از دریا چو رو پنهان کند گوهر شود"
Translation: "Corner-sitting has blessings in this desolate abode - A drop from the sea, when hidden, becomes a pearl"
Meaning: Seclusion/gathering in corners (isolation) has spiritual blessings. The metaphor: a drop from the sea, when hidden/concealed, becomes a pearl. This suggests that isolation transforms something ordinary into something precious. This is clearly positive about seclusion.
